doc: The first-match tutorial (scripts/match/tutorial.gd), short (owner, Nov 8): eight steps, one banner line each. steps: [id, the line]. %W swing or shoot, %J jump, %G glide, %E the E key, %T the Boki key, %s the Boki's name, %A an ability's name; the step's key shows as a key cap beside the line. alt: the line for part of a step (the glide half of the dash step, the Boki starting out). labels: the marker's caption per course stop or step. mob: how the tutorial's monsters differ from real ones (hp and size up, damage and attack tempo down). cds: the share of its usual time every ability and dash cooldown takes here (0.25 = four times quicker); each is also ready again when a step starts, is retried or its action lands. need: how many times a step's action must land, shown as 1/3 on the pill. The moves and rules the cut steps taught are one-time hints now (content/rules/hints.json).
steps: Land and walk to the glowing beam
Tap %T to send %s at the monster
Hold %F at the chest to open it
Step into the light at the outpost

alt.glide: Jump, then hold %G to glide across
alt.throw_send: Tap %T again to send %s at the monster

pell_doc: Pell, the guide (TutorialGuide): one short line when it stops you at the start of a step (the same %keys as the steps; the box closes itself after a few seconds), and the portrait mood for steps that are not neutral.

dash: A gap! Run off the glowing pad and dash.
sig: A whole group: that's what %A is for.
throw: That one spits from afar. Send %s at it!
fight: More of them! Beat them all, you and %s.
chest: Here's a chest key. Open that chest!
extract: The lift is open. Step into the light!
